Day 1: Capital Xchange Forum, Global Health Exhibition 2026 > Saudi Healthcare Deployment, Market Entry, FDI & PartnershipsPANEL: HealthTech Funding and M&A, From Growth Capital to Strategic ExitsA practical discussion on healthtech funding and M&A activity in 2026 versus 2025, exploring how investors are backing fewer but stronger companies, how AI and tech-enabled care are reshaping value creation, and what founders, operators and investors need to build towards strategic exits.DISCUSSION POINTS• How have funding, valuations and diligence changed since 2025?• Which AI and tech-enabled care models are attracting durable capital?• What milestones make a company strategically ready for acquisition or exit?MODERATORDr. Rana Lonnen: Healthcare and Life Sciences Investor and Advisor, Wyss Center for Bio and NeuroengineeringSPEAKERSLloyd Price: Partner and Co-Founder, Nelson AdvisorsDr. Ibrahim Alnajashi: Chairman, Najashi HoldingMansa Shroff, MBA: Vice President, Healthcare, The CFI GroupSou Miyake, PhD: Head of Venture Investment, Corundum Systems BiologyDr. Elena Lovo: Executive Director and Head of Life Sciences EMEA, Innovation Economy, J.P. Morgan

Day 2: Capital Xchange Forum, Global Health Exhibition 2026 > Allocators, LPs, GPs & Capital Formation in HealthcarePANEL: Innovation in Action, Where Are Investors Putting Their Money?An investor-led discussion on identifying emerging technologies and assessing opportunities before they reach the mainstream market.DISCUSSION POINTS• Which technologies and care models are moving into investor focus?• How do investors distinguish durable opportunities from short-lived hype?• What evidence triggers conviction before a category becomes mainstream?MODERATORFeras Mahdi: Partner, Healthcare and Life Sciences, Simon-KucherSPEAKERSDr. Ghida Harfouche: Partner, TVM Capital HealthcareAntony Kalindjian, PhD: Investment Vice President, Life Sciences and HealthTech, SoftBank Vision FundLloyd Price: Partner and Co-Founder, Nelson AdvisorsDr. Elena Lovo: Executive Director and Head of Life Sciences EMEA, Innovation Economy, J.P. MorganMina Bekheet: Founder and Chief Executive Officer, Panacea

p: 1일차: Capital Xchange 포럼, 2026 글로벌 건강 전시회 > 사우디 의료 배포, 시장 진입, FDI 및 파트너십PANEL: 건강 기술 자금 조달 및 M&A, 성장 자본에서 전략적 출구까지2026년과 2025년의 의료 기술 자금 조달 및 M&A 활동에 대한 실질적인 논의, 투자자가 더 적지만 더 강한 기업을 지원하는 방법, AI 및 기술 지원 의료가 가치 창출을 재편하는 방법, 창업자, 운영자 및 투자자가 전략적을 향해 구축해야 할 사항 탐색 종료.토론 포인트• 2025년 이후 자금 조달, 가치 평가 및 근면이 어떻게 변했습니까?• 어떤 AI 및 기술 지원 관리 모델이 내구성 자본을 끌어들이고 있습니까?• 어떤 이정표를 통해 회사가 인수 또는 퇴출을 전략적으로 준비하게 됩니까?MODERATORDr. Rana Lonnen: 의료 및 생명과학 투자자이자 자문가, Wyss 생명 및 신경공학 센터SPEAKERSLloyd Price: 파트너 겸 공동 창립자, Nelson AdvisorsDr. Ibrahim Alnajashi: Najashi Holding 회장 Mansa Shroff, MBA: CFI 그룹 의료 부문 부사장Sou Miyake, PhD: Corundum Systems Biology 벤처 투자 책임자Dr. Elena Lovo: J.P. Morgan 혁신 경제, EMEA 생명과학 부문 전무이사 겸 책임자
